# Build a Debian package from templates and taskgraph inputs together

577 adds app and language-pack templates, package preferences, installed paths, desktop actions and a release repackage kind. The repackage base config points at both template sets and the docker-image references include debian12-repackage. The historical task uses signed Linux inputs and shipping-phase promote. Current source retains the templates/config but the original release-deb-repackage kind is absent, so that old task path is not current scheduling authority. No Debian archive or taskgraph was generated.

Scope: Debian packaging architecture.
